scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
text: Applicant must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) category.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
text: Applicant must be a permanent resident of India.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
text: The annual income of applicant's parents/guardian from all sources must not exceed ₹2,500,000 (₹2.5 Lakh) per annum.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
text: Applicant must be pursuing recognized post-matriculation courses in approved institutions.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
text: Age must be between 16 and 35 years at time of application.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
text: Valid Income Certificate issued by competent authority (Max 1 year old). SC Caste Certificate issued by competent magistrate. Aadhaar Card linked with active bank account. Previous year Marksheet / Passing Certificate.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
text: Bank Passbook copy showing IFSC and Account Number. Institution Fee Receipt.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
text: Register on National Scholarship Portal (NSP) or State Scholarship Portal.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
text: Upload income certificate, caste certificate, and academic marksheets.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
text: Submit application online before the deadline of 31st October. Institution verification followed by district officer approval.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
text: Full tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance ranging from ₹2,500 to ₹13,500 per annum based on course category.
Applicant farmer family must own cultivable land registered in their name. Both small and marginal farmers are eligible.
Institutional landholders, serving/retired government employees, and income tax payers in last assessment year are ineligible. Applicant must have completed mandatory e-KYC.
Land Ownership Document (7/12 extract / Khatauni / Jamabandi). Aadhaar Card of head of family. Aadhaar-seeded Bank Account details. Active Mobile Number for e-KYC OTP verification.
Apply via PM-KISAN online portal or CSC center.
Enter land record (Khata/Khasra) details and Aadhaar number.
Complete land seeding verification by local Revenue Officer.
Financial benefit of ₹6,000 per year transferred in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 every four months directly into bank accounts.
Beneficiary family should not own a pucca house anywhere in India.
Annual family income for EWS category must not exceed ₹3,000,000 (₹3 Lakh).
Annual family income for LIG category must not exceed ₹6,000,000 (₹6 Lakh).
Family must comprise husband, wife, and unmarried children.
Income Certificate showing annual family income ≤ ₹300,000 for EWS. Aadhaar Card of all family members. Domicile / Residence Proof of urban area. Land Ownership proof or allotment letter.
Affidavit affirming no ownership of pucca house anywhere in India.
Apply online at PMAY-U official portal or through Urban Local Body (ULB). Submit income certificate, land documents, and Aadhaar.
Verification by Municipal Corporation / ULB inspection team.
Interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 Lakh on housing loans or direct financial assistance of ₹1.5 Lakh for house construction.
Applicant must be a permanent woman resident of Maharashtra State.
Age of applicant must be between 21 and 65 years.
Total annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹2,50,000 (₹2.5 Lakh).
Applicant must possess a valid Yellow or Orange Ration Card, or annual income certificate below limit.
No member of applicant family should be an Income Tax payer or permanent government employee.
Aadhaar Card of applicant woman.
Domicile Certificate of Maharashtra (or Ration Card / Voter ID proving 15 years residence).
Income Certificate (Max 1 year old) OR Yellow/Orange Ration Card copy. Bank Passbook copy (Aadhaar linked, single account). Self-declaration affidavit regarding non-payment of income tax.
Submit application through Nari Shakti Doot App or Anganwadi center.
Upload Aadhaar, Domicile certificate / Ration card, and Bank passbook. Scrutiny by Gram Panchayat / Ward committee.
Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500 directly deposited into Aadhaar-linked bank accounts.
Applicant must be a street vendor vending in urban areas on or before 24th March 2020.
Must possess Certificate of Vending / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULB).
In case of non-card vendors, Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from ULB / Town Vending Committee (TVC) is required. Age must be at least 18 years.
Certificate of Vending (CoV) OR Town Vending Committee ID OR Letter of Recommendation (LoR). Aadhaar Card. Bank Account details. Mobile number linked with Aadhaar.
Apply through PM SVANidhi portal or CSC center. Select lending institution (bank/NBFC). Upload Vending Certificate / LoR and Aadhaar.
First tranche working capital loan up to ₹10,000 (1-year tenure), second tranche up to ₹20,000, and third tranche up to ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy.
Student must be studying as a regular student in Class VIII in a Government, Government-Aided, or Local Body school.
Student must have scored minimum 55% marks (50% for SC/ST) in Class VII examination.
Parental annual income from all sources must not exceed ₹3,50,000 (₹3.5 Lakh).
Students of Navodaya, Kendriya Vidyalaya, and Sainik schools are not eligible.
Class VII Marksheet showing minimum 55% (50% for SC/ST) marks.

Parental Income Certificate issued by Tahsildar / Gazetted Officer (Max 1 year old). Caste Certificate (if applicable for SC/ST). Disability Certificate (if applicable, min 40%). Aadhaar Card and Bank Account details.
Appear for NMMS Selection Test conducted by State Education Department.
Qualify the written exam (MAT and SAT papers).
Apply on NSP portal with exam roll number and income certificate.
Scholarship of ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) for selected students studying in class IX to XII.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat PM Jan Arogya Yojana
text: Households identified under SECC 2011 data, active Ration Card holders under NFSA, or Senior Citizens aged 70 years and above (Vaya Vandana Card).

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat PM Jan Arogya Yojana
text: No restriction on family size, age or gender. Pre-existing conditions covered from day one.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat PM Jan Arogya Yojana
text: Aadhaar Card of beneficiary.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat PM Jan Arogya Yojana
text: Ration Card (NFSA / State Priority Family Card). Active Mobile Number.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat PM Jan Arogya Yojana
text: Check eligibility on PMJAY beneficiary portal or Ayushman App.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat PM Jan Arogya Yojana
text: Visit Ayushman Mitra at empanelled hospital or CSC.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat PM Jan Arogya Yojana
text: Complete e-KYC using Aadhaar and generate Ayushman Card.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat PM Jan Arogya Yojana
text: Cashless health cover of up to ₹5,00,000 (₹5 Lakh) per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across empanelled public and private hospitals.
Girl child and family must be permanent residents of Uttar Pradesh.
Family annual income from all sources must not exceed ₹3,00,000 (₹3 Lakh).
Maximum two girl children per family are eligible.
Application for birth stage must be filed within 6 months of girl child birth.
Birth Certificate of girl child.
Domicile Certificate of Uttar Pradesh (or Voter ID / Electricity bill).
Income Certificate of parents (Max 1 year old, ceiling ₹3,00,000). Aadhaar Card of mother/father and girl child. Joint photograph of girl child with parents. Bank Passbook copy of parent/guardian.
Register on mksy.up.gov.in portal.
Select application stage (Stage 1 to Stage 6).
Upload birth certificate, immunization record, or school admission proof.

Total financial assistance of ₹25,000 distributed across 6 stages: birth (₹5,000), complete vaccination (₹2,000), Class 1 (₹3,000), Class 6 (₹3,000), Class 9 (₹5,000), and Degree/Diploma admission (₹7,000).
Municipal Corporations and Urban Local Bodies in eligible cities. Cities without organized bus service receive priority.
City Mobility Plan document. Municipal Council Resolution.
State government submits proposal to MoHUA. Agreement signed with concessionaire.
Clean, reliable electric public transport services with subsidy support for bus acquisition and charging infrastructure.

scheme_name: Stand-Up India Scheme for SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs
text: Applicant must be SC/ST and/or Woman entrepreneur above 18 years of age.

scheme_name: Stand-Up India Scheme for SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs
text: Loans under the scheme are available for greenfield enterprises only (first-time venture).

scheme_name: Stand-Up India Scheme for SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs
text: In non-individual enterprises, 51% of shareholding and controlling stake must be held by SC/ST or Woman entrepreneur.

scheme_name: Stand-Up India Scheme for SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs
text: Borrower should not be in default to any bank or financial institution.

scheme_name: Stand-Up India Scheme for SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs
text: SC/ST Caste Certificate (if applicable).

scheme_name: Stand-Up India Scheme for SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs
text: Identity & Address Proof (Aadhaar, PAN Card, Voter ID). Project Report / Detailed Business Plan.

scheme_name: Stand-Up India Scheme for SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs
text: Rent Agreement / Land Ownership proof for business premise. Bank statement for last 6 months.

scheme_name: Stand-Up India Scheme for SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs
text: Apply online at standupmitra.in portal.

scheme_name: Stand-Up India Scheme for SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs
text: Submit project report, business plan, and KYC documents. Lead district manager/bank branch review.

scheme_name: Stand-Up India Scheme for SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs
text: Bank loan ranging from ₹10,00,000 to ₹1,00,00,000 for manufacturing, services, agriculture-allied, or trading sector.
Applicant artisan must be working with hands and tools in one of 18 family-based traditional trades.
Minimum age of applicant must be 18 years on date of registration. Benefit restricted to one member per family.
Applicant should not have availed credit under similar government credit schemes (PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, Mudra) in last 5 years.
Aadhaar Card of artisan. Aadhaar-linked Bank Account Passbook. Active Mobile Number.
Trade verification recommendation by Local Sarpanch / Ward Member.
Register at Common Service Centre (CSC) via PM Vishwakarma portal.
Three-step verification: Gram Panchayat / ULB level, District Implementation Committee, and Screening Committee.
Recognition via Vishwakarma Certificate & ID Card, basic 5-7 days skill training with ₹500/day stipend, ₹15,000 Tool Kit Incentive, and collateral-free loan up to ₹3 Lakh at 5% interest.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
text: Applicant must belong to OBC category of Maharashtra State.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
text: Annual family income must not exceed ₹1,50,000 (₹1.5 Lakh) for scholarship, or ₹8,00,000 (₹8 Lakh) for tuition fee reimbursement.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
text: Student must be enrolled in recognized post-matric course via CAP / merit round.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
text: Minimum 75% attendance required in current academic year.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
text: Valid Income Certificate issued by Tahsildar (Max 1 year old, showing income ≤ ₹1.5 Lakh).

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
text: OBC Caste Certificate issued by competent authority in Maharashtra.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
text: Non-Creamy Layer Certificate valid for current financial year. Domicile Certificate of Maharashtra. Previous year Passed Marksheet. Aadhaar Card linked with NPCI bank account.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
text: Apply via MahaDBT portal (mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in).

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
text: Upload income certificate, caste certificate, non-creamy layer certificate.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
text: Verification by College Principal and Social Welfare Officer.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
text: 50% to 100% tuition fee and exam fee waiver plus maintenance allowance depending on course tier.
